title: Among female patients aged 50 or older who have had at least two laboratory
question: Among female patients aged 50 or older who have had at least two laboratory tests showing abnormal red blood cell counts, identify those whose total protein (TP) has ever fallen below the normal range. For each such patient, return their ID, current age, the number of distinct dates on which TP was below 6.0, and the average deviation of their TP from the lower normal limit (6.0).

prediction.sql:
WITH AbnormalRBCPatients AS (
    SELECT "XCL_014" AS patient_id
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE "XCL_019" < 3.5 OR "XCL_019" > 5.5
    GROUP BY "XCL_014"
    HAVING COUNT("XCL_014") >= 2
)
SELECT 
    P."XCL_058" AS ID,
    STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060") AS CurrentAge,
    COUNT(DISTINCT L."XCL_015") AS TPBelowCount,
    AVG(6.0 - L."XCL_020") AS AvgDeviation
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060")) >= 50
  AND L."XCL_020" < 6.0
  AND P."XCL_058" IN (SELECT patient_id FROM AbnormalRBCPatients)
GROUP BY P."XCL_058"

WITH AbnormalRBCPatients AS (
    SELECT "XCL_014" AS patient_id
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE "XCL_019" < 3.5 OR "XCL_019" > 5.5
    GROUP BY "XCL_014"
    HAVING COUNT("XCL_014") >= 2
)
SELECT 
    P."XCL_058" AS ID,
    STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060") AS CurrentAge,
    COUNT(DISTINCT L."XCL_015") AS TPBelowCount,
    AVG(6.0 - L."XCL_020") AS AvgDeviation
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060")) >= 50
  AND L."XCL_020" < 6.0
  AND P."XCL_058" IN (SELECT patient_id FROM AbnormalRBCPatients)
GROUP BY P."XCL_058"

WITH FemalePatients AS (
    SELECT 
        p.XCL_058 AS patient_id,
        p.XCL_060 AS birth_date
    FROM Patient p
    WHERE p.XCL_063 = 'F'
      AND (julianday('now') - julianday(p.XCL_060)) / 365.25 >= 50
),
AbnormalRBCPatients AS (
    SELECT 
        l.XCL_014 AS patient_id
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN FemalePatients fp ON l.XCL_014 = fp.patient_id
    WHERE (l.XCL_020 < 3.5 OR l.XCL_020 > 5.5)
       OR (l.XCL_021 < 33.0 OR l.XCL_021 > 45.0)
       OR (l.XCL_022 < 37.0 OR l.XCL_022 > 50.0)
    GROUP BY l.XCL_014
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.XCL_015) >= 2
),
TPBelowNormal AS (
    SELECT 
        l.XCL_014 AS patient_id,
        l.XCL_015 AS test_date,
        l.XCL_030 AS tp_value
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN AbnormalRBCPatients arp ON l.XCL_014 = arp.patient_id
    WHERE l.XCL_030 < 6.0
)
SELECT 
    tpn.patient_id,
    CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(fp.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS current_age,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tpn.test_date) AS num_dates_below_6,
    AVG(6.0 - tpn.tp_value) AS avg_deviation_from_lower_limit
FROM TPBelowNormal tpn
JOIN FemalePatients fp ON tpn.patient_id = fp.patient_id
GROUP BY tpn.patient_id, fp.birth_date
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT tpn.test_date) > 0
